<a2ui>
# Absolute data model and variables initialization
$/page/title = "A2UI Express"

# Target user interface surface
surface("product-landing-page")

# Hero section highlighting the main headline, subhead, and gradient background
hero = gradient_hero(
    "Revolutionize Your Workflow with A2UI",
    "The fastest way to build beautiful, responsive user interfaces using modular component definitions.",
    "INTRODUCING A2UI EXPRESS",
    "#6366f1",
    "#a855f7",
    "linear-gradient(135deg, #e0e7ff, #f3e8ff)",
    "center",
    "Get Started Free",
    "https://a2ui.dev/docs"
)

# Feature grid containing three distinct feature columns
features = feature_grid(
    "Why Choose A2UI?",
    "Designed for speed, flexibility, and production-ready performance.",
    3,
    [
        {
            icon: "⚡",
            title: "Lightning Fast",
            description: "Compiled directly into highly optimized JSON layouts with zero runtime overhead.",
            badge: "Performance",
            color: "#3b82f6"
        },
        {
            icon: "🧩",
            title: "Modular Atoms",
            description: "Construct complex structures easily using a robust library of pre-styled components.",
            badge: "Design System",
            color: "#10b981"
        },
        {
            icon: "🎨",
            title: "Tailwind Styling",
            description: "Modern visual patterns inspired by Tailwind UI and MagicUI out of the box.",
            badge: "Themes",
            color: "#f59e0b"
        }
    ]
)

# Testimonial card highlighting customer satisfaction
testimonial = testimonial_card(
    "A2UI has completely transformed our design-to-code pipeline. What used to take days now takes minutes, allowing us to rapidly prototype and ship beautiful landing pages.",
    "Sarah Jenkins",
    "Lead Frontend Engineer at TechFlow",
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108377-be9c29b29330?w=150",
    5
)

# Primary call-to-action section highlighting next steps
cta = cta_section(
    "Ready to build your next big idea?",
    "Join thousands of developers and designers already building the future of UI with A2UI Express.",
    {label: "Start Building Now", url: "https://a2ui.dev/signup"},
    {label: "View Component Library", url: "https://a2ui.dev/docs/components"},
    "#f8fafc"
)

# Constructing the layout into columns to structure the page sections cleanly
root = columns(
    1,
    "2.5rem",
    "stretch",
    [
        {blocks: [hero]},
        {blocks: [features]},
        {blocks: [testimonial]},
        {blocks: [cta]}
    ]
)
</a2ui>
